comparison.diverging_part: polygons versus spheres, and therefore an additive perimeter energy weight versus the multiplicative scale inheritance of the recorded NSC response
comparison.scope: combinatorics and recursion structure only; no wavefunction, no amplitude, no measurement of the actual universe
comparison.structural_claim: both families are nested wrappings of contiguous blocks; the NSC spherical chain is the small-Schroeder (path bracketing) skeleton, and the cosmohedron polygon Matryoshka is that skeleton raised by the triangulation freedom, which is why its count is factorial

weight_comparison.cosmohedron_per_bracket: inverse of the sum of the entering energies
weight_comparison.nsc_per_level: one inverse factor, argument rescaled by 1/Omega
